subject: Insurance
title: Self-Driving Car Insurance Dilemma
description: A quick win: understand Self-Driving Car Insurance Dilemma.

hook.text: If a self-driving car crashes, who pays.

buildup.text: Traditional auto insurance assumes a human driver.

discovery.text: Some propose manufacturer liability: the self-driving system's builder bears all accident costs via product insurance.

twist.text: Hybrid vehicles (driver-assist, not fully autonomous) create the worst ambiguity.

climax.text: Autonomous vehicles require a complete rethinking of liability.

punchline.text: Car crashes, nobody was driving. Insurance law hasn't caught up.

quiz.question: Why do self-driving cars create an insurance dilemma?
options: It's unclear who bears liability—the owner, manufacturer, or software company
